title: Origins of strength stabilities at elevated temperatures in additively manufactured refractory high entropy alloy
process_description: prepared by directed energy deposition (DED) technique using a mixture of pure Ti, Hf, Nb, and V powders (all with purities exceeding 99.95 %). A remelting procedure with ultra-high energy input was applied. Argon maintained oxygen content below 200 ppm. Parameters: scanning speed 5 mm/s, hatching space 381 μm, laser power 550 W, remelting power 800 W, layer thickness 200 μm.
